At Amdocs, our mission is to empower our employees to 'Live Amazing, Do Amazing' every day. We believe in creating a workplace where you not only excel professionally but also thrive personally. Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable them to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world.  



**In one sentence**
-------------------

As a Senior Agentic Software Engineer – Cloud Migration, you will design and build AI agents that automate key steps of cloud migration programs: discovery, assessment, migration planning, wave design, and infrastructure\-as\-code generation. You’ll combine your cloud/infra expertise with GenAI and multi\-agent orchestration to create reusable, platform\-agnostic accelerators used across Amdocs Cloud Studio engagements.
  

You’ll work in a cross\-functional “agentic squad” with architects, data engineers, and the R\&D foundation team to turn real customer migration patterns (e.g., VMware exit, OpenShift, hybrid cloud) into enterprise\-grade agentic solutions.


**What will your job look like?**
---------------------------------

Key Responsibilities
  

* Design and implement LLM\-powered agents that support:

o Environment discovery and inventory analysis
  

o Workload classification (6Rs), grouping, and dependency mapping
  

o Migration wave planning and landing zone recommendations
  

o IaC template generation (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  

* Collaborate with the foundation/platform team to:

o Use shared memory, context, and orchestration frameworks
  

o Contribute new “agentic primitives” (e.g., workload analyzer, IaC generator) for reuse
  

* Integrate agents into cloud\-native services (APIs, microservices, or workflows on Kubernetes/serverless).
* Implement guardrails, evaluation, and observability for AI behavior (metrics, logging, test harnesses).
* Partner with Cloud Studio architects and delivery teams to turn field patterns into reusable accelerators.
* Contribute to demo environments and portals (e.g., self\-service migration demos for presales and events).
* Document designs, decisions, and patterns in a way that others can reuse and extend.

Common Skills \& Experience (All Agentic Engineer Roles)
  

GenAI \& Agentic Systems
  

* Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs via APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Bedrock / others).
* Practical experience with at least one framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar for building LLM/agentic apps.
* Strong prompt \& context engineering skills: structuring system prompts, chain\-of\-thought hints, retrieval contexts, and examples.
* Experience building tool\-using agents (e.g., agents that call code analyzers, cloud APIs, or databases).
* Understanding of RAG patterns (retrieval\-augmented generation): embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search, and when RAG vs. fine\-tuning is appropriate.
* Exposure to multi\-agent orchestration (e.g., task decomposition, agent\-to\-agent handoff, shared context/state machines) is a strong plus.
**All you need is...**
----------------------

Software Engineering \& Architecture
  

* 5–8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience.
* Strong coding skills in Python plus at least one of: TypeScript, Java, Go, or .NET.
* Experience building APIs, services, and CLIs, and integrating them in a cloud environment.
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native patterns: microservices, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability; ability to design systems that can be debugged in production.
* Strong testing mindset: unit tests, integration tests, plus basic understanding of LLM evaluation approaches (golden datasets, scoring, human review loops).
Ways of Working
  

* Ability to work in cross\-functional squads (architects, engineers, UX, PM, domain SMEs).
* Experience in consulting, professional services, or product engineering is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain complex designs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving R\&D environment with iterative discovery and delivery.

Cloud Migration – Domain\-Specific Skills
  

Cloud \& Infrastructure Expertise
  

* Hands\-on experience with at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Strong understanding of on\-prem \& virtualized environments, particularly VMware; familiarity with migration tools/approaches (e.g., VMware exit, lift\-and\-shift, replatform).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure\-as\-Code:

o Terraform strongly preferred
  

o CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM/CDK is a plus
  

* Solid grasp of:

o VPC/VNet design (subnets, routing, NAT, load balancers)
  

o Identity \& access management (IAM, RBAC)
  

o Security \& compliance considerations (data residency, encryption, network segmentation)
  

Cloud Migration Concepts
  

* Familiarity with cloud migration strategies (6Rs/7Rs, wave planning, landing zones, blueprinting).
* Experience with:

o Application and infrastructure discovery/assessment

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain innovative science solutions to accelerate our business.

* Master's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing
* Experience in patents or publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience in professional software development
* Experience implementing algorithms using toolkits and self\-developed code

* PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* 5\+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Knowledge of architectural concepts and algorithms, schedule tradeoffs and new opportunities with technical team members

title: Sr. Engineer - Digital Imaging
description:
**About Evident Digital Pathology**
Evident Scientific, formerly part of Olympus Corporation, is a global leader in life\-science microscopy and optical instrumentation. Following the recent acquisition of Pramana, a pioneer in Autonomous Digital Imaging, Evident has combined its world\-class optical heritage with Pramana’s software, robotics, and AI innovation to define the future of Digital Pathology.
Our young, high\-performing engineering team has already taken the industry to its next node in autonomy—building the world’s most advanced whole\-slide imaging platform, deployed at the Mayo Clinic to create the world’s largest digital pathology archive. Today, this technology is trusted by more than 30 top\-tier medical institutions across the U.S. and Europe, powering Clinical workflows directly aiding in patient care.
As part of Evident, this team is now advancing to the next level of autonomy—moving from autonomous imaging to intelligent imaging, where scanners, data systems, and user interfaces are self\-aware, adaptive, and capable of real\-time AI inference at the edge.**Role Summary**
As a Senior Engineer in Digital Imaging, you will research, design, and develop advanced imaging algorithms and work closely with cross\-functional domain experts to translate innovations from concept to production. You will play a key role in improving image quality, algorithm performance, and intelligent imaging workflows for whole slide imaging (WSI) systems. **Key Responsibilities**
Design, build, and optimize imaging algorithms for image segmentation, classification, and enhancement (e.g., tissue specimen analysis on glass slides and whole slide images).
Apply strong understanding of color spaces (RGB, HSV, LAB, etc.) to improve image processing pipelines.
Collaborate with the image quality evaluation team to continuously improve WSI scan quality across diverse specimen types.
Develop and maintain end\-to\-end algorithm models for imaging parameters and acquisition sequences, enabling intelligent, content\-aware imaging routines.
Partner with platform and software engineers to co\-optimize algorithms and production software implementations.
Mentor and guide junior engineers in image processing and analytics best practices. **Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or a related field with emphasis on image or signal processing.
Proven hands\-on experience delivering at least one full R\&D cycle, transitioning image acquisition and processing pipelines into production platforms.
Strong knowledge of image processing algorithms, color spaces, and image quality challenges.
Solid foundation in mathematics, including probability, algebra, and calculus.
Excellent programming skills in C/C\+\+ and Python; hands\-on experience with machine learning libraries is essential.
Understanding of sensor and camera component interactions within imaging systems.**What Will Make You Stand Out**
Strong background in image processing, optics, or signal processing.
Demonstrated innovation through patents, publications, or impactful research contributions.
Hands\-on experience with deep learning frameworks and neural network architectures.
Experience with compute engines and tools for graphics, computer vision, and ML/AI workloads.
Solid understanding of statistical modeling, probability theory, and stochastic methods.

**What’s the role**

As a Senior Data Scientist within the Digital Process Twin (DPT) portfolio, you will lead the end\-to\-end technical design and build of process\-centric ML/AI solutions—owning runtime reliability and reusable assets as a individual contributor. You will apply process mining, optimization, and AI/ML techniques to process\-centric data to identify inefficiencies, predict process behavior, and optimize end\-to\-end business performance. You will collaborate closely with engineers, architects, and fellow data scientists to design scalable analytical solutions and integrate them into Shell’s process\-mining ecosystem.


The Digital Process Twin Centre of Excellence (CoE) aims to *“Empower Process Transformation through Digital Process Twins”* by advancing process\-mining and analytics capabilities. Shell is recognized as an industry thought leader in process intelligence, pioneering innovative analytical methodologies and data\-driven process transformation. The CoE collaborates with academic institutions, industry forums, and technology vendors to drive innovation and applied research in process analytics.


If you are passionate about building advanced analytical models using process event data and developing intelligent solutions that enhance operational agility and enable autonomous processes, we invite you to join us as a Senior Data Scientist driving Shell’s digital process transformation journey.


**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the technical architecture and reusable design patterns for analytical solutions — including discovery/ideation workshops with business stakeholders — from problem framing and data design to deployment and run operations.
* Define canonical process\-data models and event\-data standards; build versioned, reusable pipelines (with case IDs, activities, timestamps, attributes) from SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.
* Apply process\-mining to discover patterns and root causes; engineer features from event logs and quantify improvement opportunities against target KPIs.
* Build and productionize ML/OR models on process event data (classification, anomaly detection, forecasting, prescriptive optimization) to enhance business\-process performance.
* Implement and enforce MLOps standards—CI/CD, versioning, automated tests (leakage/drift/fairness), model registry, and observability—with defined SLOs and rollback/playbooks; embed RAI/XAI by default, and ensure these standards are adopted consistently by Data Scientists across projects.
* Collaborate with data engineers and software developers to embed and scale models in Shell’s process\-mining platform for reliable, near\-real\-time analytics.
* Establish evaluation frameworks and a quality bar—offline benchmarks, shadow/canary runs, A/B or interleaving tests, and drift monitoring—tied to business KPIs (e.g., cycle time, STP%, backlog, rework).
Collaborate with academic and industry partners (vendors, startups, open\-source communities) to bring external perspectives, co\-develop prototypes, and translate research into production (PoCs benchmarks* deployment).
* Act as technical SME and raise the team’s technical bar via design reviews, code reviews, pair\-programming, coding exercises/workshops, and learning sessions.

**What you bring**

8–10 years in applied data science/ML/OR, including* 2 years with process/event or behavioral data at enterprise scale.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
End\-to\-end production delivery record: shipped* 3 production ML/OR solutions from design to stable run (CI/CD, versioning, observability) with defined Service Level Objectives (SLOs), demonstrating KPI uplift, and executing safe release/rollback procedures; embedded Responsible/Explainable AI (RAI/XAI).
* Applied ML/AI \& OR algorithms: hands\-on with supervised/unsupervised learning (classification, clustering), time\-series forecasting, anomaly detection, graph/process\-mining methods, and prescriptive optimization/simulation; strong model selection \& trade\-off reasoning (features, evaluation, cost\-of\-error).
* Process\-data modeling \& standards: canonical event/process schemas, schema/versioning \& data\-quality standards (lineage, validation, freshness), and governed, reusable pipelines/feature sets; experience with schema evolution and late events.
* Platforms \& packaging: integrated models with Celonis/Signavio (or equivalent) and open\-source tooling (e.g., PM4Py/ProM); packaged solutions as services/components adopted by other teams.
* Performance \& reliability: optimized cost/latency/throughput (profiling, vectorization, caching); built runbooks and dashboards that reduced Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR) and prevented regressions.
Research production (with academia): led PoCs benchmarks* deployment with academic partners; reproduced state\-of\-the\-art (SOTA) results and translated them into maintainable production systems.
* Technical influence as a senior IC: raised the team’s technical bar via design/code reviews, pair\-programming, coding exercises/workshops, and learning sessions; improved test coverage, reuse, and documentation.
* Rapid prototyping \& incubation: turn new ideas into quick, decision\-quality prototypes; design baselines, A/B or interleaving tests where relevant, and drive a build/kill/iterate path based on impact and cost.

**Must have Skills:**

* Python \& SQL, production\-grade code (tests, packaging, git).
* Process/event data modeling \& process mining (discovery, conformance, enhancement; features from event logs).
* Applied ML/AI \& OR: supervised/unsupervised, time\-series, anomaly detection, graph/process\-mining, prescriptive optimization.
* MLOps in practice: CI/CD, containers, experiment tracking \& model registry, monitoring/observability with SLOs, safe release/rollback, RAI/XAI.
* Technical leadership as a senior IC: lead design/code reviews, mentor data scientists, co\-design with DE/PM/PO, run discovery/ideation workshops, and document decisions clearly.
* Cloud \& data platforms: Azure/AWS/GCP; Spark/Databricks (incl. jobs/orchestration exposure).
* Platform integration: embed models into Celonis/Signavio (or equivalent) for near\-real\-time analytics.
* Performance engineering: profiling, vectorization, caching; cost/latency/throughput tuning.
* Tech transfer \& enablement: collaborate with academic/industry partners; coach via pair\-programming and coding exercises/workshops.
* Decision narratives for executives: translate experiments and model performance into clear recommendations with risks, trade\-offs, and expected impact; build decision\-ready dashboards/briefs.

**Nice have Skills:**

* Open\-source process\-mining \& feature/graph stores (PM4Py, ProM, Feast, Neo4j).
* Change leadership \& training: playbooks, brown\-bags, reusable templates that scale practices across teams.
* Community impact: publications/patents or meaningful open\-source contributions in process intelligence/applied AI.

description:

In the current dynamic automotive landscape, your role is to provide real\-time, proactive insights that eliminate risk before it impacts production. Working within a high\-performance team, you are required to be agile and amicable team player. You will transform complex datasets into actionable intelligence, enabling executive leadership to make informed, strategic decisions.


  
* Education: B.E./B.Tech in a Technical/Engineering field (Required); Specialization in Supply Chain Operations Research is an additional advantage. Data Science knowledge is preferable.

* Technical Skills: Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), SQL, and advanced Excel. Familiarity with AI/Machine Learning applications in SCM is highly preferred.

* Risk Modeling: Utilize data science methodologies to identify regional concentrations, geopolitical vulnerabilities, and supply chain constraints.

Operational Management

* Playbook Support: Assist in the development of proactive mitigation playbooks by providing the data\-backed foundation for derisking and regionalization strategies.

Digital Integration \& Collaboration


* AI Integration: Collaborate with IT partners to feed cleaned, validated N\-Tier data into Ford’s AI\-driven resilience dashboards.
* Cross\-Functional Support: Provide technical data support to Global Purchasing, Engineering, and Material Planning and Logistics teams during supply crises or strategic sourcing reviews.
* Visualization: Create high\-impact data visualizations that simplify complex supply chain dependencies for senior management briefings.

We are looking for a **Data Scientist** with deep expertise in **Computer Vision** to lead the development of intelligent systems that can interpret the physical world. Whether it’s using satellite imagery to track carbon sequestration, deploying Vision Transformers for structural health monitoring, or leveraging VLLMs to query vast libraries of site photos, your work will turn pixels into actionable engineering insights.

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Solution Architect – mRounds(Business\-First Technology Leadership)**

### **Location**: Hyderabad, India

### **Employment Type:** Full\-Time; Salaried

### **Compensation:** Base Salary, Bonus, Stock Options, Medical

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**


Innovapptive is a **category\-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.


Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These customers have achieved tangible, hard\-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile\-first and AI\-enabled workflows.
* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.


Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost \& Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field\-proven ROI.


Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high\-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next\-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting\-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.


Today, with over **300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3\-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

### **The Opportunity**


We are seeking a **Solution Architect – mRounds** who combines **deep problem\-solving capability**, **business\-first thinking**, and **technical architecture leadership**.


This is a **customer\-facing, delivery\-aligned role** that bridges business outcomes, digital architecture, and system reliability. The Solution Architect acts as the **\#1 problem solver and technical escalation point**— ensuring that every Innovapptive implementation achieves fast adoption, seamless reliability, and measurable value realization.


You will work hand\-in\-hand with Solution Consultants (domain experts), Implementation Leads, and Engineering to design resilient architectures, address adoption\-blocking non\-functional requirements, and drive enterprise\-grade solution performance.

### **How You Will Make An Impact.**

#### **1\. Business\-First Problem Solving**

* Act as the customer’s trusted technology advisor to diagnose and resolve roadblocks impacting adoption, reliability, or performance.
* Translate frontline pain (e.g., sync issues, latency, connectivity challenges, poor UX) into actionable technical and process resolutions.
* Lead RCA sessions to identify architecture or configuration issues slowing time\-to\-value.
* Ensure all solutions are designed to drive quantifiable business outcomes in **safety, reliability, and cost take\-out**.

#### **2\. Architecture Leadership \& NFR Ownership**

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for customer implementations — including **security, scalability, performance, and offline reliability**.
* Define and validate NFRs: Wi\-Fi resilience, offline sync strategy, SSO (SAML, OAuth2\), API and integration architecture, and deployment models (public/private cloud).
* Partner with customer IT and engineering teams to ensure solution readiness and compliance with enterprise standards (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001\).
* Create detailed architecture artifacts: solution blueprints, data flow diagrams, API integration maps, and configuration matrices.

#### **3\. Adoption Acceleration \& Value Realization**

* Measure and drive improvements in **crash\-free sessions, sync reliability, latency, and uptime** to ensure world\-class user experience.
* Collaborate with Solution Consultants to link architecture quality with operational KPIs (e.g., MTBF, Safety accidents rate, PM/CM).
* Participate in Executive SteerCo sessions to present technical risk mitigations, adoption progress, and reliability metrics.

#### **4\. Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the bridge between **Professional Services, Product Engineering, and Customer IT**, ensuring fast issue resolution and proactive design governance.
* Provide hands\-on technical mentorship to implementation consultants and engineers.
* Champion architecture governance across all customer programs, driving consistency and reusability.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities through field\-derived insights.

#### **5\. Continuous Improvement \& CoE Contribution**

* Contribute to the Solution Architecture Center of Excellence by developing design accelerators, troubleshooting frameworks, and NFR playbooks.
* Institutionalize best practices in reliability, performance tuning, and scalability.
* Support internal readiness initiatives and coach teams on architecture\-driven delivery excellence.

### **What You Bring to the Team**

* **8–15 years** of experience in **Industrial SaaS**, **APM** **EAM**, or **Connected Worker Platforms** (SAP PM, IBM Maximo, Oracle eAM, or Infor EAM).
* Strong background in OT systems integration — designing end\-to\-end architectures that connect plant\-floor systems (DCS/SCADA, historians, PLCs) with cloud, EAM, and connected worker platforms
* Proven expertise in designing **cloud\-native, mobile\-first architectures** with offline sync, API orchestration, and enterprise\-grade security.
* Strong grasp of **Operations, maintenance, reliability****,** and ability to translate them into digital solutions delivering tangible business value.
* Experience with **AWS/Azure cloud services**, **MuleSoft/Boomi/Logic Apps**, and API testing tools (Postman, Swagger).
* Deep understanding of **non\-functional requirements** — performance, scalability, data privacy, availability, and user experience.
* Exceptional problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical thinking with strong executive communication skills.
* Experience in **Agile SaaS delivery models** with distributed onshore/offshore teams.

### **Preferred Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in **Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Systems**.
* Certifications preferred:
	+ **AWS/Azure Solutions Architect**
	+ **TOGAF or equivalent architecture frameworks**
	+ **CMRP, CAMA, or equivalent reliability certification (Good to have)**
	+ **PMP or SAFe Agile(Good to have)**

### **Why Join Us**

* Be the **architect of reliability and adoption** for the world’s leading industrial brands.
* Influence how industrial SaaS is designed, delivered, and scaled globally.
* Collaborate with top minds in maintenance, operations, and technology.
* Work in a culture that values **initiative, ownership, and measurable impact**.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-linked rewards, and comprehensive benefits.

**Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms.**


Innovapptive is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

30 Jan 2026 11:59pm
**Job Title**

IT Tester
**Job Summary**

As an Automation Test Specialist, you take ownership to lead key enhancements in digital functions and ensure Telstra is investing in the right areas to deliver our T22 Strategy. You are responsible for driving innovative ways to test platforms that service our internal and external customers and promote analytics and robotics process automation for our tool and platform maintenance.
  

  

You bring a breadth of skills and experience in automating testing for a software platform (frontend and backend); as well as expertise in building out automated deployment pipelines that support ongoing automated testing. Your knowledge in best practice standards for CI/CD delivery, expertise in technical leadership and analytics, and ability to deliver proactive automated remediation are critical to success in this role.
**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Us:**

At Telstra, our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. It's a future that won't happen on its own, it has to be delivered — and only Telstra can bring together all the parts to create it. Telstra is on a mission to redesign the way we all connect \- with leading\-edge technologies and solutions that are changing the world. And this is where YOU come in, by playing your part to building in help our customers connect: faster, better and smarter.  



**Why Telstra?**

Telstra is a well\-known Australian company that has been around for over 100 years. We are the leading telecommunications and technology company in Australia and have been operating internationally for over 70 years. We have a strong presence in over 20 countries. In India, we have offices in Bangalore, Mumbai, and Delhi, as well as an Innovation and Capability Centre in Bangalore. We are focused on using innovation, automation, and technology to solve major technological challenges in areas such as IoT, 5G, AI, and machine learning. Joining Telstra gives you the chance to make a difference in the lives of millions of people and have a rewarding career with flexibility.


**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Build next\-level test automation suites for UI, APIs, and backend services that integrate seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive shift\-left testing, ensuring bugs are caught before they become production nightmares for all of us.
* Be a test strategist \& automation pro—optimize frameworks, scale test coverage, and make testing faster and smarter across Telstra.
* Work side\-by\-side with developers to bake quality into every stage of the software lifecycle—testing isn’t a final step, it’s part of our Telstra journey!
* Work with developers to design for testability and enable faster feedback loops across application and process.
* Analyze test results, provide data\-driven insights, and continuously improve automation strategies to developers.
* Stay ahead of the curve by researching and experimenting with cutting\-edge testing tools and techniques and implement which suites Telstra’s quality need.

**Technical Skills:** 

**Automation\-First Testing**

* More than 5 years of experience in Manual and Automation Testing
* Design, develop, and maintain robust **test automation frameworks** for web, and API layers.
* Implement **TDD/BDD practices** and integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Use tools like **Selenium with Java, Playwright, Appium, Rest Assured, and Cucumber** for automation.

**Shift\-Left Quality**

* Embed quality from the earliest stages of development.
* Collaborate with developers to write **testable, high\-quality code** and coach teams on best practices.
* Drive **early defect prevention** and continuous improvement

**Agile \& DevOps Integration**

* Actively participate in **Agile ceremonies** (stand\-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives).
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to optimize pipelines and enable **continuous delivery** .
* Support production deployments and regression testing during fix\-on\-fail windows

**Quality Leadership \& Coaching**

* Act as a **quality engineer** , mentoring teams and influencing best practices.
* Set quality standards and create test strategies aligned with Telstra’s **AI and automation\-first approach** .
* Work closely with Product Owners, Business Leads, and Quality Engineering Leads to ensure alignment.

**What’ll Give You Bonus Points**

* You’ve run workshops or training to help teams improve their testing game.
* You’ve worked in telecom (OSS/BSS)
* You know a thing or two about security testing, mobile automation, or contract testing and comfortable talking about those and get hands dirty when needed.
* You’ve dabbled in AI\-driven test automation (or are super keen to learn).
* Experience in performance and load testing at scale.

**What can we offer you?**

At Telstra, you can thrive, your way. We foster new ideas, we embrace different ways of working and thinking, and we believe an inclusive and diverse team will lead us to innovate for the future.


We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. To enable everyone to participate, we’ve developed an ‘All Roles Flex’ policy to consider flexible ways of working for every role. To learn more, visit our Telstra Careers Website: http://tel.st/allrolesflex

description:
Meet the Team
  
  

The post\-pandemic years have exposed inherent biases and limitations in human\-driven and statistical/Traditional ML\-based forecasting approaches. Cisco wasn’t immune and saw a sharp increase in backlogs, inventory levels, and supply chain costs. The Forecasting Data Science Team within Global Planning is solving this by pioneering the application of Causal AI to revolutionise Demand Forecasting and its Enterprise impact. We’re working to provide breakthrough levels of regime\-resilient forecast accuracy, efficiency, and prescriptive insights that enable decision makers across Cisco and its Supply Chain to plan effectively.
  
We are a bright, engaged, and friendly global team working with an industry\-leading Causal AI ecosystem. Gartner has ranked Cisco’s Supply Chain to be \#1 or \#2 in the world over the last 5 years, and recognised this team in their Power of Profession 2024 Supply Chain awards as one of the top 5 in the Process and Technology Innovation category.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

You will bring your skills, experience, and innovation to play a significant role in shaping our Causal AI\-based forecasting system to improve decision making and drive operational performance and efficiency across Cisco’s Enterprise and Supply Chain functions.
  
  

**Responsibilities :** \-
  
  

* Develop, evolve, and sustain key elements of the Causal\-AI based Forecasting system for Aggregated Demand.
* Analyse and sharpen the causal consideration of global financial markets, macro\-economics, micro\-economic and competitive factors in the Demand Forecasting models.
* Engineer model features from broad internal and external structured and unstructured datasets, discover and enhance the natural segmentation for Demand based on these factors, determine causality of the factors, and incorporate them into structural causal models.
* Develop high\-quality, accurate models that are robust and have a long shelf life.
* Solve challenging research problems that push the boundaries of structural causal modelling and scale to Enterprise and Supply Chain business applications.
* Work closely with business leads and experts in Global Planning, other Supply Chain functions, Finance, and other Cisco organisations to understand relationships and patterns driving Cisco demand.
* Develop and evolve reliable approaches for uncertainty quantification to enable scenario/range forecasts
* Research and develop new methods to reconcile between forecasts at multiple product hierarchy levels, multiple time horizons, and different forecasting approaches.
* Leverage and incorporate appropriate machine learning approaches including customisation of recently published research as needed to build better Causal AI solutions.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to junior data scientists and data engineers in the team, helping shape the skillsets and values of the next generation of Cisco data scientists.


Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 6\+ years of Advanced Analytics experience with a Masters Degree or 4\+ years with a PhD in a Mathematics or Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Econometrics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related quantitative field.
* Great foundation in AI and machine learning, with a theoretical and practical understanding of Causal machine learning approaches.
* Expertise in Python, with sophisticated data analysis and data engineering skills, including using SQL, experience git version control.
* Demonstrated structured wrangling and mining skills from data, and problem\-solving skills using machine learning, including in real\-time hackathon\-like settings.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills with an ability to unpack sophisticated problems, and articulate AI/ML approaches, solutions, and results for non\-technical audiences.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with global financial markets, macro\-economics, micro\-economics, econometrics, and financial datasets.
* Meaningful experience using Causal AI and Structured Causal Models in time series settings.
* Meaningful experience in time series forecasting for demand use cases and/or other sophisticated or dmultifaceteddomains like marketing/pricing
* A practical and effective approach to problem\-solving using AI/ML and a knack for envisioning, translating business requirements into analytics requirements, and realising feasible data science solutions.
* Demonstrated team leadership, project management, and business stakeholder influencing skills
* Experience mentoring team members to improve their own technical and project management skills.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
